message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine depicts a person's face and hand peering through horizontal metal blinds. The person’s right eye is wide open, staring through a gap created by fingers prying two slats apart. Inside the brown iris of the eye, the number "2026" is printed in small white font. The hand, with thick, rounded fingers, holds the upper slat open. The blinds are metallic grey with horizontal highlights and shadows.

The top of the illustration features the word "TEMPO" in large white capital letters, with a tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" underneath. A red rectangle is positioned at the top left. The date "5-11 JANUARI 2026," price "RP 60.000," and other publishing details appear in the top right, alongside a barcode and QR code.

The phrase "INDONESIA 2026" is printed in small black letters on one of the upper slats. In the lower half, three black rectangular boxes are superimposed over the blinds, each containing a white word: "REPRESI," "TANPA," and "HENTI." The background behind the person is solid black.
